lines.t:
The preparation time that accompanies the <c:ffff00>act<c> of an
<c:ffff00>action<c> or <c:ffff00>Medaforce<c>, from when the command is
chosen until it is executed. Its length varies with
the abilities of the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>.

If the <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> during {{prep}}, the act is
interrupted and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> begins immediately.
